reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI panel for inspecting token and context usage, navigating complete session message history, and browsing workspace files.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面右侧提供会话 Token 与上下文用量、完整消息目录跳转以及工作区文件树查看功能。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side DeepSeek Harness panel for viewing token and context usage, navigating the full message history, and browsing workspace files.

capabilities: Displays token usage and context-pressure information for the current session
Reconstructs and displays a full historical message outline from persisted session logs
Reads directory entries and file metadata within configured workspace roots
Opens selected workspace files with the operating system default application
